notes: All 12 views inspected. Two complete grip variants (wood panels and blue-tape wrap) plus a separate magazine and a single cartridge. Slide serrations, ejection port, sights, trigger guard, safety lever and grip screws are modelled; top and bottom views show the bore, chamber and magazine well correctly. A high-zoom crop of the receiver, slide and grip confirms there is no manufacturer wordmark, logo or serial anywhere on the weapon.
limitations: Recognisable real-world service-pistol pattern; the design is unbranded but some marketplaces restrict weapons content regardless of licence.
Static assembly: the slide, trigger and magazine do not articulate in the shipped glTF.
The cartridge is a loose prop, not chambered.
method: Visual inspection of local-model renders and technical reports
